---
title: '\textsf{HABITAT report}'
output: pdf_document
params:
  output_dir: "."
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
results_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "results")
temp_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "temp")


#function to read csv and return df
read_csv_return_df <- function(file_path) {
  if(!file.exists(file_path)) {
    warning("File not found: ", basename(file_path))
    return(data.frame(NULL))
  }
  data.frame(read.csv(file_path))
}
```

## \textsf{model inputs}

```{r inputs}
training <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "training_data.csv"))
testing <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "test_data.csv"))
features <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "feature_matrix.csv"))
classes <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "class_matrix.csv"))

kable_data <- data.frame(
  n_train = nrow(training),
  n_test = nrow(testing),
  n_classes = ncol(classes),
  n_features = ncol(features)
  )

knitr::kable(kable_data, 
             caption = "`model inputs`"
             )
```


```{r predscores_overview}
scores <- read.csv(file.path(results_dir, "pred_scores.csv"))
if (nrow(scores) > 0) {
  counts <- data.frame(table(scores$isolate_source))
  colnames(counts) <- c("host", "count")
  predictions_overview <- data.frame(counts)
  knitr::kable(predictions_overview, caption = "`host counts among test set`")
} else {
  warning("pred scores has no rows")
}
```

## \textsf{posterior distribution}

```{r predhist, out.width='90%', fig.align='center'}
files <- list.files(file.path(results_dir, "plots"), pattern = "png", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(files) > 0) {
  knitr::include_graphics(files, dpi = 150, auto_pdf = TRUE)
} else {
  warning("No plots found.")
}
```

## \textsf{zoonotic fraction}

```{r zoonotic}
zoonotic_frac <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(results_dir, "more_results", "zoonotic_frac_summary.csv"))
if (nrow(zoonotic_frac) > 0) {
  summary <- data.frame(n_human = zoonotic_frac$n_human_test,
                        fzec_prop = zoonotic_frac$fzec_prop_cut0.80,
                        fzec_frac_mean = round(zoonotic_frac$zoonotic_frac_mean,3),
                        ci_low = round(zoonotic_frac$zoonotic_frac_ci_2.5,3),
                        ci_high = round(zoonotic_frac$zoonotic_frac_ci_97.5,3))
  knitr::kable(summary, caption = "`zoonotic fraction`")
} else {
  warning("zoonotic fraction has no rows")
}
```

## \textsf{meta information}

```{r jags_overview}
jags_parameters <- data.frame(
  seed = config$JAGS_DATA$seed,
  chains = config$JAGS_DATA$chains,
  iterations = config$JAGS_DATA$iterations,
  burnin = config$JAGS_DATA$burn_in,
  thin = config$JAGS_DATA$thin,
  saved_params = paste(config$JAGS_DATA$save_parameters, collapse=",")
  )
knitr::kable(jags_parameters, caption = "`Jags parameters`")
```

`for R-hat, values should be < 1.1`
```{r r_hat}
rhat_summary <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "rhat_summary.csv"))
knitr::kable(rhat_summary, caption = "`R-hat summary`")
```

```{r feature_counts}
fc <- read_csv_return_df(file.path(temp_dir, "feature_counts.csv"))
if (nrow(fc) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(fc, caption = "`features`")
} else {
  warning("feature counts missing.")
}
```
